title: How my team stopped shipping broken code
hook: As an AI developer, there's one thing I did that helped my whole team push code that wasn't broken (on screen: how my team stopped shipping broken code, with one Claude plugin)
summary: Claude Code plugins stopped my team pushing broken PRs to GitHub.
body: Claude Code plugins stopped my team pushing broken PRs to GitHub.
We had a lot of PRs going up with errors and bugs. The fix was one Claude plugin: a backpack of tools and rules Claude loads every session.
Now when anyone on the team commits, the plugin kicks in, verifies and checks everything works as intended, and only then does the PR go to GitHub.
Plugins are guardrails. They make sure your implementation is correct before anyone else has to review it.
How would you use a Claude plugin in your workflow? Comment PLUGIN with your idea 👇
